conclusions.text: The complete 45-component roster resolves one-to-one to pinned custody shards. The exhaustive 45×519 source search yields 51 positive-area intersections across all 45 components; exact current-admin boundary overlays classify seven positive-length neighbors and one point-only Kota Bontang contact. No source geometry was repaired or buffered.

Physical cause, dry-land status, local positional accuracy, legal authority, and BIG polygon reuse remain unresolved. The 21 numeric-closure IDs and 1,078,088,489.3853252 m² route area sum are inherited source-relative diagnostics. No geography approval, correction, import, release change, or publication is proposed.

A pinned BIG 2022 KSP geometry query produced 47 positive-area component-feature intersections across 43 components; two have no intersection in the bounded returned subset. This does not establish official jurisdiction, legal authority, completeness, positional accuracy, or whether unmatched geometry reflects a source gap. Reuse rights remain unknown.
